svg.text: I turn ideas into real web products. End-to-end UI, APIs & data.

g.text: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
• Single-flight cache stampede protection & strict RBAC security guards.
• Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) across 10+ core modules.
• Low-latency WebRTC peer-to-peer voice rooms with sub-100ms audio routing.
• Python FastAPI backend integrated with ElevenLabs conversational AI voice.
• Instant optimistic UI feed mutations with TanStack React Query caching.
• Live academic study channels powered by Supabase Realtime & RLS policies.
• 60fps spring-physics interactions, Lenis smooth scroll & zero layout shift.
• Verified 100/100 Core Web Vitals with automated Playwright E2E test suite.
"Good engineering is not just about writing code — it's about building something that matters."
